name: hh-arc-signer
notes: Settlement signer for Hopping Heads Arc. Holds SIGNER_KEY and nothing else; the game server never sees it. Register from its own clone of the repo so the pin cannot move the game server's checkout. Env (SIGNER_KEY, SIGNER_TOKEN, CHAIN_ID, ESCROW_ADDRESS, PORT, BIND) lives in Pier; see .env.example. Deploy checks out the reviewed commit named in deploySteps, never pulls.
